reviews.text: Highly recommend! I had to take my dog in last night at 1:30 am. Every single person there was kind, helpful, and patient, with lots of empathy for me and my dog. They also very thoroughly go over the treatment plan. The price was totally reasonable for an emergency situation. I also discovered that they credited my account for a test they didn't end up having to run. What an amazing place!  He's feeling much better thanks to them.

I have worked with VEG staff in a professional capacity but it was my first time on the other side bringing my own fur baby in. My cat Nala is spicy and not the easiest patient by far. They took it in stride, and provided her the same care as they would an affectionate and loving cat. Nala has been having some chronic health issues and Dr. Meyer explained this recent flare up to me in detail, and recommended next steps. Nala’s nurse Andres was outstanding, she was working very hard but still providing Nala with attentive one on one care. I was very sleep deprived and forgot I had a prior obligation, and they let me leave to deal with that before coming back. As you can see from others’ photos they also have an outstanding facility with comfortable amenities. Thank you VEG❤️

Had a great experience taking my dog to SD VEG ER. This was the first time going to this clinic. We were seen by a doctor immediately to triage the situation.The staff were kind, attentive and communicated often with you - not leaving you in limbo while waiting. The overall wait time was very reasonable. I appreciated the care they showed my dog. I would highly recommend SD VEG ER for Pets.

Hands-down, the absolute best veterinary ER that I have ever been to. I love the fact that you can stay with your pet during the entire treatment. The staff went out of their way to make sure that both my pet and I were comfortable throughout the night. I cannot say enough wonderful things about this facility and their staff.
Great emergency service at VEG in Mission Valley. Been here twice with 2 different digs and both times we were seen immediately and experienced knowledgeable and caring Dr's. and staff

VEG was on a list of recommended ERs from my primary care. I went in on a whim because I needed to get my dog Max in very quickly. Beyond the vibe of the place, which allows you to be with your pet through the majority of treatments, the veterinarians are smart, capable and experienced. Dr. Meyer treated Max and diagnosed him with Addison's Disease. I was emotional and was trying to pay attention through it, but she was pretty sure about his symptoms even before the tests came back positive. I like and trust that. My primary care vet received the test and notes of his treatment and gushed about and complimented Dr. Meyer.  I wanted to thank Dr. Meyer, Nurse Enrique and staff for saving Max. Go with confidence. The bill is what it is, but worth having my pal next to me for long while. Thank you to infinity ∞! 🙏🏻❤️

Incredible experience for my pet and myself. This place is full of people who really care and are so thorough and professional. Dr Kalb and nurse Toni were beyond amazing. I would recommend this place to anyone in need of emergent care for their furry friend.

Service was very professional and staff answered all my questions.  Very friendly and hospitable.  They tended to my husky needs. He came in with a dermititus breakout from a recent nueter surgery clipper burn and flea bites. They were able to examine and treat his condition. Prescribed antibiotics,  flea treatment,  pain meds. He is feeling alot better and healing. We are just waiting for his F/U with vet to finally take cone off. I recommend this hospital and will use again in the future.

To the best vet ever for emergencies! VEG in Mission Valley is incredible. When you get there you park, and all the care happens right in front of you. They don't just take your dog to the back where you never know what's going on. You stay right there with them, on the sofas or on the floor. They start triage right away and the doctor examines your dog right there in front of you. No hidden rooms unless the situation is really bad.

My 15-year-old dog came in with vertigo. He couldn't walk straight and was so dizzy, which made it a very tricky situation. The vet was so thorough, talking through everything from the physical exam to his legs and arthritis, to what might be going on with his spine. I never felt rushed or left in the dark for a second.

Five stars. They truly deserve it. If your pet ever has an emergency, come here.

Very disorganized and it doesn’t feel like anyone knows what’s going on. We’ve emailed photos from our cats surgery several times to the email address they gave us and suddenly no one can find them or give us a green or red light on the photos of recovery looks normal. This is just another money hungry clinic eager to take your money and provide ZERO support for after care!

This past Friday we had a regular vet appointment for our senior cat whose hind legs suddenly stopped working. We were confused because he was still alert and eating, and despite our existing vet appointment we decided to take him in to get evaluated.

We discovered unfortunately it was more serious than we thought (blood clot, embolism).

VEG ER showed a high level of professionalism, cleanliness, communication and transparency during a really emotional and traumatic time for us. Out of the three cats we've had the privilege of owning, it was easily the best and most dignified end of life we've ever experienced as pet owners. No high-pressure sales tactics, no guilting into buying diagnostics, tests, labs or on-going care for a situation that had a poor outlook.

I wouldn't hesitate to take our future pets here and it is great to know we have a 24/7 emergency hospital we can trust.
thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you, thank you, from the bottom of my heart, thank you.
Everyone was amazing. Dr. Swan is extremely knowledgeable and caring for animals.

Amazing experience from start to finish! The entire team was incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely cared about my dog. They acted quickly when we needed them most and saved my dog’s life. I can’t thank the veterinarians and staff at VEG ER for PETS enough for the care, compassion, and attention they gave him. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and made a stressful situation so much easier. Absolutely amazing service—I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone who wants their pet in great hands. Thank you for everything! 🐾❤️

I will never forget what happened here when I brought my boy in during an emergency.

My dog was critically ill, and I was terrified that I was going to lose him. While he was still being treated, I was approached and told that I needed to come up with  $3,000 or treatment would be stopped just after a couple hours in. A couple hours!!!! I was already watching my best friend fight for his life, and in that moment, being confronted with that amount of money was absolutely devastating.

What I cannot accept is how it made me feel afterward. I felt like because I could not simply produce thousands of dollars immediately, my boy’s life was somehow worth less. I needed compassion and communication during one of the worst moments of my life, and instead I felt pressured and completely helpless.

My biggest concern is that after it became clear that I did not have unlimited money, I did not feel that everything possible was being done for him. I cannot know what decisions were made medically or what ultimately could have changed the outcome, but from my experience, I left feeling that my boy was not fought for the way I believed he deserved to be fought for.

He was not “just a dog.” He was my family, my constant companion, and the one who had been beside me through some of the hardest years of my life. I brought him there believing he would receive emergency care and that we would be treated with compassion.

Instead, I left without him.

I understand that emergency veterinary medicine is expensive and that hospitals have financial policies. But there is a human being standing in front of you when their animal is dying. That person is already breaking apart. They should not be made to feel that their ability to pay determines how much their companion is worth.

I am still grieving, and I still cannot accept what happened that night. I will never forget how helpless I felt standing there while my boy was fighting for his life.

I hope this review makes the hospital understand that behind every emergency case is a family who loves that animal deeply. Compassion should never disappear when the money becomes difficult.

Caring, thorough, worked quickly, and overall amazing team. Even cared for my own emotional well being. Only thing that sucks is the cost but they don’t control that and their emergency care is worth it.

Visiting from out of state and had to make a trip after my dog was being sick from too much salt water at the beach. The staff were amazing and super friendly, everything was so efficient! Would highly recommend!

I cannot say enough good things about this place! Pricey? Yes, but so worth it if you’re able to make it work. I took my 12 yr old Labrador Serena in about a week ago and I was helped from the moment I walked through the door. Serena ended up having pyometra and when I explained my concern about cost for a surgery they provided me with several options, including helping me find another hospital that might be more cost effective.  There was never any pressure to do the surgery with them, however because of how well we were treated from the get go I didn’t want to go anywhere else. From beginning to end the staff was so helpful and you can really tell they all love what they do and all genuinely care for your pets well being. Special thank you to Dr. Lance Day who really took the time to sit with me and explain things, answer questions, and was overall very transparent in what was going on with Serena. He was very reassuring and called us as soon as the surgery was done. His positive and patient  demeanor really made me feel comfortable about leaving Serena over night.

The entire staff at both Encinitas and Oceanside locations took great care of my dog.

I appreciated their attentiveness and patience. Team members are friendly and knowledgeable.

Being able to stay by your pet during the entire healing process helps greatly.

I highly recommend these facilities. Thank you!
Amazing emergency care for my dog, who I was able to stay with the entire visit. Vet and staff are very professional and kind, and the care was top level.

Thank you for your wonderful 5-star rating! We're truly grateful to hear that your experience with us was a positive one. Your satisfaction means a lot to us, and we’re committed to serving you and others with care and dedication.

We’ve been here twice now once with our senior cat and once with our dog. Both times the experience was a 12/10.

My wife and I both agreed that this has been the best veterinary experience we’ve ever had, both in terms of the team and the level of care. When we came in with our senior cat, Dr. Yaghoobian was absolutely incredible. I was a nervous wreck, but how genuinely caring he was really showed, and it made me feel so much better knowing she was in such good hands.

Everyone in the building was incredibly accommodating and kind. We were honestly pretty bummed to find out they don’t offer general veterinary care, because these doctors are vet goals. We’re so grateful for the care our babies have received here and would recommend them without hesitation.

The most compassionate and professional Emergency Vet I have ever encountered. Our Corgi Biscuit hurt his paw playing outside, and Dr. Smallcomb and her entire staff showed such care to get him taken care of. Even when putting him for sedation, they put him in a lovely room with the blinds drawn and gentle music playing to make him comfortable. Just absolutely extraordinary.. thank you so much to all of you!

Dr. Lance Day and his staff provided exceptional care and treatment for my pet. Their understanding and compassion were invaluable to me. I am immensely grateful for their services and fortunate to have entrusted them with the care of my beloved pet, Ghost.

Best Veterinarian I have ever had the honor to take care of my animals. She knows her stuff and quickly gets to whatever is the problem with the animal or whatever I am doing wrong, and provides the solution.I love a Veterinarian that loves her work. I can tell she loves animals and right away when I see her looking at mine see her concern and focus on my animal; not daydreaming about Billing and whats next on the shopping list. She is very engaged with her work. You can rest assured you have one of the best Veterinarians there is with Dr Vergette.
AMAZING PLACE. If your pet is in dire need of help go here! the staff is very knowledgeable and really a attentive and very personable.

As a long-time dog parent, I’ve unfortunately had several visits to the emergency vet over the years.  When my elderly dog needed emergency care recently, I tried VEG for the first time.  The experience was unlike any I’ve had before… from the moment we walked in the door to the moment we left.  I was able to be with my dog the ENTIRE time!  I was in control the entire time. The doctor was kind and compassionate.  Should I have an emergency in the future, I will NEVER go anywhere else.
Dr. Hensley and all the staff were amazing!

I had occasion to have an emergency vet care situation of a good friends dog yesterday and felt compelled to share my thoughts and feelings on this place.  I drove my friends with their critically sick dog yesterday and watched from behind.  From the moment I walked into their store all I heard from their employees was how much this was likely to cost.   There were several of their people working on his dog it just seemed to be all about the $.  I have friends who take their pet down to TJ and  from what these people who we're telling my fried could cost him $20 000.  Tried to get $2500 today and seemed bummed that we were considering going to Mexico.  I font know why anyone should feel bad about not having 20k to throw down on a random Monday.  I walked out an hour later feeling fairly disgusted about my friends dead dog and their sales practices which seemed predatory!

I am so grateful to have found Veg ER. After a long day in Tijuana, I arrived home and took my cat out of his crate and I discovered his IV catheter was left in. Extremely frustrated, I contacted the VCA first and they told me it would be around $200 to remove it. In addition to that, they said they had a lot of patients and there could be a bit of a wait. I contacted Veg ER after and they immediately told me this would be no problem and they would remove it FOR FREE. I arrived shortly after and they quickly removed it. No wait. I was out of there within 5 minutes. The staff at Veg ER truly saved my day. I will 100% come here if I ever have a pet emergency. I truly appreciate their kindness.

Judith and Dr. Chuck are amazing! Our 5-year old 7-lb Maltipoo was lethargic yesterday and clearly was in some pain. We woke up this morning and our dog was shaking and favoring his back legs. I called Veg ER and within 20 minutes we were in their facility and were being checked in. They were patient, kind, understanding, and very comprehensive in their recommendations. While our dog is still recovering, we have a plan of attack and a clear idea of what to do next. While I never want to be back here (obviously!), we will absolutely go back if another emergency arises!

Sincere thank you to the VEG Team for their expertise and kind compassion with my sweet Chuy a few days ago. I heard the Team was efficient and caring in minimizing her suffering; only my spouse was present and was allowed to grieve privately.

I already miss her terribly but I am comforted that she and my family were in good hands.  🖤

The absolute best experience, could not have asked for anything better out of an emergency vet.  Accommodating to not only the pets but also me as an owner answering all my questions and keeping us comfortable while waiting and treating our little girl.

The staff and Dr. Bronstein were outstanding. Dr. Bronstein explained things clearly and had a clear plan. He spoke with a specialist hospital to expedite the referral and even took the time to research the pet insurance I have without my asking. I was impressed with his expertise and compassion. Thank you.

Took GREAT care of my dog Messi after his abdominal surgery. I was welcome to visit and stay with him for long periods and they kept me informed. Liked the detailed printed discharge instructions as well.

I cannot recommend VEG enough. Last night, we were transferred to VEG from another emergency vet due to our dog Kona requiring emergency surgery for a horrific case of closed pyometra. (Side note— PLEASE don’t be like me… you NEED to spay your dogs!!!)
We were greeted by Kyla in the front immediately, and she was fantastic. She was so sweet, helpful, and friendly and helped us feel so comfortable and at home.
We immediately got comfortable, got Kona comfortable, and were helped right away by Dr. Swan and Marissa. I highly recommend Dr. Swan. She was quick, accurate, honest, and so helpful. She explained to us the risks and rewards of surgery and brought us an estimate. Marissa was so sweet and sat on the floor with Kona and got her blood done painlessly and was so kind and helpful. Dr. Swan checked all of her levels to make sure she was stable for surgery and they immediately treated her with fluids and medication to prep her for her surgery. The whole team worked together to prep her for surgery and we got to stay with her the whole time. Her surgery was quick and Dr. Swan and Dr. Jason were very quick to let us know she was out safely, let us know details of the surgery, and let us know we could be there for her while she woke up. Dr. Swan even stayed late so that she could help our Kona. We stayed with her until she woke up and she received amazing care from the team (Josey, Marissa, and multiple others whose names I cannot remember). At that point we went home for the night.
Dr. Jason sent us a message in the morning to let us know Kona was doing well and that he was passing her on to the next vet. Mid morning we got the call that she was stable and eating and we were able to come get her much earlier than expected. We were refunded funds that were unused during her stay in a timely manner and we felt that we were treated extremely fairly (of course emergency pet med is expensive, but they were very transparent throughout the process). When we got there, Stephanie helped us understand medications and gave us updates on Kona before taking her home. Kona LOVED Stephanie and even wagged her aussie nub at her, so I know she was well cared for.
Thank you so much Dr. Swan— you saved our girl’s life. We are forever grateful for you & how you’ve given our girl many more years with us.
Thank you to the whole team working the night of 8/14 and morning of 8/15– you are all incredible and we had an amazing experience and so did our Kona.

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your feedback and are thrilled to hear that your experience with us was so positive. Your support inspires us to continue leading with excellence.
These guys have always been super helpful. Good listeners and always provide the best care possible.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We genuinely appreciate your feedback and are glad to hear that your experience with us met your expectations.

Absolute heroes. Everyone from the triage team to the nurses to the doctors helped my little guy who ate an entire roll of medical tape and an AirPod (apparently some medication made him very hungry) - they were able to solve the problem quickly, with care, would absolutely advise bringing your pets here if you need to. Hopefully won’t run into this situation again.. but if I do, VEG ER all the way. Thank you everyone for saving my little guy.
- Dude and G
Exceptional team and exceptional experience for an emergency. Couldn’t recommend this team more. You can really tell they care for every animal like their own

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Five stars across the board.

I brought my cat, Ram Dass, here after he experienced a fainting episode. After diagnostic testing, he was hospitalized for further care.

From the moment we arrived, every doctor, veterinary technician, and receptionist treated us with incredible compassion and professionalism. They allowed my daughter and me to stay with Ram throughout the night, patiently answered all of our questions, and provided exceptional care every step of the way.

Knowing he was in such capable hands gave me the peace of mind to go home for a few hours and get some much-needed rest. They stabilized Ram and supported not only him, but our entire family during an incredibly difficult time.

A special thank you to the receptionists for their kindness toward my daughter and to everyone who played a part in caring for Ram. We are truly grateful for everything you did.

I will never take any of my pets anywhere else for emergency care. Thank you for treating Ram Dass like one of your own.

it was my big boys time after 11 years due to cancer & internal bleeding. veg er helped us through the traumatic experience, but did it with such warmth and care. every staff member there is fantastic. they even sent us a personal card in the mail with my boys paw & nose print. rip bane <3 and thank you everyone at veg er for being amazing people

I was awake all night already when my big dog and my little dog got into a fight. My small dog was in pain and I rushed him in to the the emergency. They were so kind to promptly help my little old man but also went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable, they allowed me to rest in a room while my dog was being cared for. I never expected this level of care for my puppy but also for me. As a business owner that has two pet grooming salons I think the level of costumer service for the four paws clients and but also to the pet parent is what make this business so special. My puppy Kronos is recovering well thanks to their help. Would give them 10 stars if I could, everyone was so kind.
Staff were amazingly friendly, attentive, and caring throughout the entire emergency process

Absolutely wonderful team we had a scare with our cat that was blocked as soon as we took him in the care started they where able to un block him and never kept us in the dark about anything they let us be with him every step of the way from blood draw to sedation they are all professional they are one of the best teams I have ever known thank you so much I can't tell you how grateful I am to yall

Everyone here is amazing and thoughtful. The first time I came, my cat suddenly collapsed and they treated her with so much care. The second time I came was the day we had to put her down which was so difficult and they made me feel supported. They got the bloodwork back so fast and they are very efficient. The bubbly water machine is awesome and it’s very clean inside and a comfortable place to be. Thank you for all that you do. I really appreciated the card in the mail with my cat’s paw prints and pieces of beautiful hair.

The team at VEG ER is amazingly kind, helpful, and effective. They've treated my dog, Kiitos, on multiple separate occasions (for bite wound, surgery, kennel cough, etc.). Listened to our concerns, suggested a treatment plan (along with alternatives), gave us regular updates, and most importantly, took great of Kiitos. I'm very grateful for all their help, and would highly recommend them!

I had an extremely disappointing experience at VEG ER for Pets on Camino de la Reina. We waited nearly 4 hours just to be seen, and the clinic wasn’t even busy. My dog was coughing nonstop and appeared to be choking, yet no one seemed concerned enough to check on him while we waited. They didn’t even offer him water or provide any comfort during that time.

When we were finally seen, the veterinarian barely examined my little guy before handing me a large bill and telling me there was “nothing wrong.” That was incredibly frustrating because he’s clearly coughing and choking on something. I left feeling like my concerns were dismissed and that the focus was more on charging me than actually figuring out what was wrong with my dog.

I expected compassion, urgency, and a thorough examination from an emergency veterinary hospital. Unfortunately, I experienced the exact opposite. I wouldn’t recommend this location based on my experience.

Had to bring my dog here in the middle of the night. The team was great, very friendly, gentle with my dog and very communicative about wait times and how much longer we would be there. Reasonably priced and was even able to speak with a doctor before coming in to not waste my time or theirs. Had to bring him back the next morning since he was still wasn’t eating but Dr. Day was great and didn’t even charge me to reevaluate and do another ultrasound. Definitely would recommend going there for your ER visits.

Actually, I write this place a 4.8.
At first, I thought I went to the wrong place because there was no traditional waiting room and reception area. The entire place was opened. I presume they had trauma cases and more serious cases in private rooms, but everything else was out in the open for the most part.
Someone greeted me immediately. My pup was offered a comfortable mat to lie on if he chose. The veterinarian was friendly, receptive, and explain things well. x-rays and labs were relatively promptly.
While waiting, the premises were comfortable. There was a coffee machine and every sort of water you can imagine was available. Snacks were provided. Even the bathroom had all sorts of sanitary products. The only thing that would’ve been a nice addition to the bathroom would be a hook on the door.
There was another woman waiting for her pet, and she had lengthy concerns. The staff patiently stayed with her and answered all of her questions.
The location was convenient and easy to find.
Not all staff were naturally warm and fuzzy, but everyone was nice.
After too many bad experiences at other emergency vets with my previous dog, I am sold that this is my go to place. I hope I will never need them again, but this is where I will go.

This review is largely excluding cost, because although there were many positives about it, the overall cost of vet care is insane.

I came here after driving around all morning looking for a place that had a vet available for immediate attention. The person who I spoke with at Uptown recommended this place. I had never heard of them but they were super close to everything so I went over.

The whole experience from the moment I walked in was so much better than anything I have experienced in the 25 years I have been taking dogs to vets. We never had to leave our dog's side. We saw everything that was happening around and got to see them work in true worst case scenarios. They were kind, professional, attentive, and worked hard to care for every animal around. Our girl was not doing well and given my experience at other vets, I don't know if she would have made it had we taken her elsewhere.

I had my kids with me all day the first day. A 4 year old and 1 year old in an open space with sick animals and lots of equipment isn't ideal. They have iPads to watch movies, snacks, the good water machine, coffee, tea, coloring books, puzzles, etc. I think the sceen time and snacks the day prior (and the stress of seeing our Pep so sick) made the behavior a little less than ideal the 2nd day so we got a private room. I probably was not in my calmest state, either, but they were all amazing and kind. My husband brought our baby home this morning. My littlest is already stomping around saying "Peppy! Peppy!! Hi Peppy! Peppy Baby!" She is home and happy and largely unaffected by the stress of the last few days. I really think she is doing so well not only because of the vet care she received, but also because of the environment at this clinic.

As for the cost - like I mentioned, vet care is sooo expensive. Was it a lot of money? Yes. Worth it? Yes. It isn't like we can't pay it nor wouldn't have paid more if necessary, but it just adds up quickly. I don't have to tell anyone how expensive life is here in San Diego. HOWEVER, they honored our request to approach testing incrementally, and they even said things like, "let me look at the finances and see how far we can stretch out the hospital stay with what you have paid." You never hear stuff like that. And when I asked about tests, they were honest in that we could totally get them if we wanted, but they knew we didn't want to blindly test and they didn't think the results from other tests made it necessary. It usually is what it is and everything is done out of your sight anyways. We got out of the 2 day hospital stay and a bunch of testing and meds for a little over 6k. And the experience itself was definitely better in every way. If you have an emergency, I highly recommend VEG!

Couldn’t say enough great things about this place. Thank you for saving my doggy Lincoln after going into anaphylactic shock from stepping on a bee. They kept me calm, kept me updated while stabilizing him, and because of their prompt treatment my Lincoln is at home snuggled up in my lap, with his emotional support tennis ball. Thank you all so much!!!
Excellent experience in a time of crisis. The staff are professional, communicative, efficient, and compassionate. Thank you for all you did for Lincoln with a special appreciation to Dr. Yaghoobian.

My experience with veg absolutely exceeded my expectations. My sweet boy, Murphy, was seen almost immediately upon arrival. The care team were kind and empathetic to both our sweet Murphy, as well as to me and my wife. They made what is a stressful and upsetting situation into feeling secure and supported. They included me and my wife into every step of Murphy’s care, explained the whole procedure he went through, and answered our many, many questions (we are helicopter cat moms haha). I called constantly to check on Murphy’s care while he was being monitored and never once did the staff make me feel like I was being an inconvenience, even if they were likely busy. Overall, I would recommend veg to any pet parent 110%, the staff are kind, patient, supportive, and their love for animals and what they do is evident. They saved my baby’s life, and I am forever grateful to the staff.

They get a star for answering the phone. I am homeless and presently in need of emergency service for my bully mix, I called and they won't help unless there is money. They said to call the humane society who won only helps if you surrender your friend. You greedy people are heartless.  So I get to keep making calls and praying my friend won't die because humans are greedy and I won't surrender her, knowing I am her home and best friend and all she knows and she's already scared as it is. You humans are a pathetic lot

My three-year-old basset hound was hospitalized for six days at VEG with a life-threatening illness. Every doctor, and all of the many vet techs and staffers at VEG, were incredibly kind and treated me and my dog like family. Their competence as care providers, their compassion and their ability to communicate frequently both in person and on the phone at all hours was unlike anything I’ve ever experienced. The ER itself was a place unlike any other vet facility I’d been to. One giant room with a staff of caring people tending to pets and pet moms n dads. You never have to leave your pet. I spent hours with my dog sitting on the floor in his kennel. Staffers brought me pillows, blankets, drinks and snacks. They charged my phone. Answered all my dumb questions. Gave me hugs and comfort and brought tissues when I cried. Because of their amazing expertise, my dog was able to come home today. I am forever grateful to this ER, its managers, and the awesome people who poured out their hearts to us and gave my fur baby the love and the chance he needed. THANK YOU VEG!

First time here and we will 100% be coming back for any future emergencies with our dog (hopefully not too many times lol). Our girl was taken care of from the second we walked in to the minute she left. We were able to be there with her the whole time, and all the staff were such a joy. Grateful it wasn’t life threatening—even then they still treated her with priority and made us feel heard. Thank you to the team! She says thank you as she’s currently on her pain meds lol
This is a great emergency vet! Very supportive and comforting. They explain the issue and try to resolve it quickly if they can. I will definitely go back if my dogs ever need emergency care!
Thank you for your outstanding 5-star rating! We're thrilled to hear that your experience with us was so positive. Your confidence in our services motivates us to keep exceeding expectations.
Thank you for your positive rating! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us and appreciate your support as we strive to make the most of every opportunity.

I will never not recommend this place for all your emergency veterinary needs. I love that if you have a question you actually talk to a vet and they don’t always say bring the dog in unless they thinks a true emergency. I have called a few times and only had to bring my dog in once. When I did they treated her promptly and the price was fair and reasonable. They are very kind and knowledgeable and aren’t just out to get money. The only thing I had to get used to was there not being a lobby but it was really cool seeing everything and being able to be with your pet if they’re truly crashing. Oh also thank you to dr. Kelly (I forgot her last name but her first name was Kelly) for helping out Skye in my panicked time of need. Also,  Thank you veg for being amazing!!

Everyone here was kind, caring and attentive and took the time to listen and communicate throughout the process. They kept me well informed and were very efficient through the entire process even when there are very serious cases happening. And I didn’t have to wait hours even though my dogs issues were more mild than some. Excellent staff and great clean setup they have too.
Great place and caring staff

I read the other reviews beforehand and cannot express enough how much I agree that VEG is 5 star from start to finish.

Was directed here by another veterinarian because it was an urgent wound on his paw and with the first call to VEG to arrival and check in shortly afterwards, the communication and process was professional, efficient, honest and thoughtful with expectations and the follow thru, outstanding!

The Doctor did an amazing job with the deep wound, expertly applying sutures, stitches and care to close and protect it from any infection and put him on the path to full recovery.

I arrived at VEG a v very concerned animal lover and returned home, with my dog well taking care of and next steps clearly communicated both verbally and in writing.

Team VEG rocks!

Absolutely stellar. For anyone who considers their pets/animals family- this should be home-base for emergencies. We have 12 pets and have been through alll “the things” for years. This event was a first; one of our sweetest hens was attacked by a dog. We live in Point Loma and got there in less than 15 min. Dr. Day and a big team got us in as soon as possible and took EXCELLENT care of our girl, Poppy. As a long-time pet owner it MUST be said that- it is OUR commitment upon getting pets, to understand that emergencies are expensive and take time. We were MORE than happy to wait as long as needed for care and pay a fair rate. VEG went above and beyond, in their usual day of crisis, to help us. If I could give 100 stars I would.

I highly recommend this place just because they are so honest. My 4 month old kitten was open mouth panting and I brought her here and before an exam they had a doctor look at a video of her playing and told me it probably is nothing but normal kitten play but to come back if she is at rest and wheezing. They didnt pressure me for an exam, didnt make me go through stress for a bit of money. They even stated upfront if I wanted an exam how much exactly it would be. (205) Ive been to vet clinics or animal hospitals where they will try to sell me anything banking on me being scared enough to buy it. They were friendly, open and honest and thats a huge win. I will hopefully never have to come back but if I do I know I wont be scammed.

Our dog ate a whole corn on the cob so we took her in around 8:30pm. Everybody from the minute we got into the building were so genuine and caring. Kenny and Dr. Kelly made sure we knew what was going on, and explained every step while not being dissmive of any of our concerns. The staff were able to get our dog into emergency surgery that night! The receptionist even set up a futon with sheets, blankets and pillows for us to make sure we could rest while we waited for her surgery to be completed.

If we ever have another emergency we will only go here!
I highly recommend VEG ER they were really great with taking care of my cat. Everyone was very helpful, professional and nice.

My dog was in hospital for 3 days. Each and every person who I interacted with and who interacted with her, was amazing. Dr. Day, Dr. Batiari, Dr. Cain, and Dr. Meyer’s made us feel supported and heard. Every time I called for an update, I was connected with the doctor who was treating my dog. Something you don’t find anywhere else. Their reassurance and care is unmatched. The staff working with these doctors are also remarkable and able to make scary situations more manageable. I could not recommend VEG more.

WOW!! If you can’t stand the thought of your pet going into the backroom because you have the ability to help keep them calm in a stressful emergency… this is a win. I hope it encourages pet owners to work with sensitivities in their pet to be great grooming and vet clients. The more your pet is calm the more they enjoy care. THIS PLACE IS A TREASURE!!! It is open concept with privacy rooms that are offered based on need and volume of patience. A good trick is to call ahead if your pet can be stabilized to have better odds of not overflowing the system. My cat had something wrong with her eye. I called at midnight (when all troubles happen) to check how long she would wait (Friday at midnight). I decided to squeeze in right after the boneyard shift in hopes other critical situations were handled and I would have netter chances of my cat not having to be around vocal wanna be famous performers… lol I was so lucky my plan worked perfectly. The weekend before I had an emergency to have to put my service dog down. I had the grace of God help me with that!! But if for some reason I would have another emergency (please Lord God give me a break!) I hands down would come here. Although if your pet really needs that last moment to just be at home. It was worth going that route because he was experiencing grand mal seizures and I feel any stress could have set him off and things not be as great. So take some time to find reliable sources and have the ability to access your pet to do whats best! This is my ER for life! Telling all my customers!!

Thanks to this amazing group of animal lovers, our baby was given the best care one could hope for and has made a full recovery. We got to be with our kitty, Thomas, the entire 48 hours he was hospitalized. It truly made all the difference in keeping us both calm during this stressful time.

A special shoutout to Ellie for going above and beyond and treating our Thomas like her own.

Another for Dr. Cain. She works incredibly hard and has amazing bedside manner. She really cared about Thomas and his recovery.

The entire staff was wonderful and we only encountered positive people who just want to help pets and their families.

This is the golden standard for ER visits and will no doubt be our top choice moving forward.

Love to you all ❤️

Attention Dog Owners: Apoquel Toxicity in Cats

If your dog is on Apoquel, please be aware that the chewable treats are very palatable and enticing to cats. These are extremely toxic to cats. Keep stored in a safe area.

Let this place be your spot for any animal emergency.  Thank you so much for your empathy, understanding and professionalism.  Dr. Jason, Erica and Isaac went above and beyond to help my sweet KOBA.

My dog was having some potential medical issues. I wasn't sure if I should come in, so I called and asked if I should bring him in given his symptoms. The vet (Dr Serafina?) said it's probably fine given his symptoms, and she wouldn't be concerned unless there were additional symptoms. She suggested I watch his symptoms, and told me what they would test for if I brought him in, full with a cost estimate.

She saved us a hefty veterinary bill, and our dog is totally back to normal. This, ladies and gentlemen, is what I call integrity. They clearly care both about their patients and customers. We are new to SD, but we know for a fact that if we ever have a veterinary emergency, we will be coming here, and we will be asking for Dr Serafina.

VEG ER is amazing. They have a very caring team and I credit them with saving my dogs life after he was exposed to methamphetamine at dog beach. After we were released from the hospital we had several concerns. Each time I called I was able to immediately speak with a doctor. Truly exceptional care. Thank you all so much!

I went in because my dog had a foreign object stuck in her. I literally can’t say enough wonderful things about this staff. Our dog is our family member and they treated her as if she was there’s too. Dr. Serafin was amazing. She went over options and we decided on surgery. Before that the staff kept our dog, coco, comfortable and I was able to be with her the entire time! I was able to watch the surgery as well but I chose not to and the staff talked me through the entire surgery, after she was done and about an hour after surgery they brought her into the room where I was sleeping, yes you can stay over night there! And she slept with me hooked up to her IV and all. I LOVE this concept. I truly think this helps our animal heal so much more quickly. I’ve never seen anything like this but for a dog like ours who is extremely sensitive and attached to her family this was the greatest thing for her. My kids came the next day and she immediately ate her food she hadn’t wanted to eat in days. This is the BEST place to get true CARE for you animals. I could not recommend them more. I wish this could be coco’s primary vet. I’m going to come back and write specific names on here of who helped me and coco because you there were multiple people that treated us like family. Thank you VEG for saving our sweet coco.

I came in with my 7 year old border collie in the middle of the night after she was attacked by multiple dogs. They performed a 6 hour surgery and comforted both of us as much as they could.
